$about: capability -> the code globs that must move with its spec (R11). Copy this to specs/capability-map.json and replace the capabilities with yours.
Keys starting with $ are metadata rather than capabilities: this note, and $unclaimed below.

The paths are the paved monorepo shape - apps/* for anything deployed, packages/* for what is never deployed on its own. A single-package repo writes src/** and has no packages; the mechanism is identical.

Glob syntax: * stays inside one path segment; ** spans any number of segments including none, so apps/*/src/**/payment/** covers apps/api/src/payment/capture.ts as well as apps/api/src/routes/v2/payment/capture.ts.
